place.title: Place {ref} (pressure sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 6 header pins into column f, one pin per row: VCC into {hole.vcc}, GND into {hole.gnd}, SCL into {hole.scl}, SDA into {hole.sda}, CSB into {hole.csb}, SDO into {hole.sdo}. The small board lies over the left half of the breadboard, its metal sensor facing up.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture. CSB and SDO get no wire.

why: {ref} measures air pressure, temperature and humidity with its tiny metal-capped sensor. The Pico reads them over I2C: SDA (data) and SCL (clock). It runs on 3.3 V only: this board has no regulator.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its I2C lines stay at the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.i2c_sda: {pin} is the I2C{bus} data line (SDA): the Pico and {ref} send their bytes on this wire.
wire.i2c_scl: {pin} is the I2C{bus} clock line (SCL): it sets the pace for the data on SDA.
